title: HGRP: Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network for Routability Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.20209v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Routability prediction enables rapid evaluation of placement quality without routing, providing effective feedback for routability-driven placement optimization. Recent machine learning methods have achieved efficient routability prediction through data-driven approach. However, their prediction performance highly depends on the capability of input representations to capture essential circuit information. To address the limitations of existing circuit representations in simultaneously preserving logical topology, physical layout and routing resource information, this paper proposes HGRP, a heterogeneous graph neural network for routability prediction. HGRP models the cells, nets, and routing grids as distinct types of nodes and explicitly represents topological connectivity, spatial mapping, and grid adjacency, thereby constructing a heterogeneous graph representation that preserves multi-level circuit semantics. translated_title: HGRP：用于可布线性预测的异构图神经网络
translated_abstract: 可布线性预测无需实际布线即可快速评估布局质量，为可布线性驱动的布局优化提供有效反馈。近年来，机器学习方法通过数据驱动的方式实现了高效的可布线性预测。然而，其预测性能高度依赖于输入表示捕获关键电路信息的能力。为了解决现有电路表示无法同时保留逻辑拓扑、物理布局和布线资源信息的局限性，本文提出了HGRP，一种用于可布线性预测的异构图神经网络。HGRP将单元、线网和布线网格建模为不同类型的节点，并显式表示拓扑连接、空间映射和网格邻接关系，从而构建了能够保留多层次电路语义的异构图表示。
tldr: 提出异构图神经网络HGRP，将单元、线网和布线网格建模为不同类型的节点并同时保留拓扑连接、空间映射与网格邻接等多层次电路语义，从而在无需布线的情况下实现高效准确的可布线性预测。
en_tdlr: HGRP, a heterogeneous graph neural network that models cells, nets, and routing grids as distinct node types while preserving multi-level circuit semantics (topological connectivity, spatial mapping, and grid adjacency), enabling efficient routability prediction without routing.
